classdef.name: CrossReference
classdef.shortdesc: A cross reference to a different index topic. (For cross references in text, use the 'cross reference source' and 'hyperlink' objects.)

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the CrossReference.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the CrossReference (a Topic).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the CrossReference within its containing object.

property.name: referencedTopic
property.shortdesc: The topic to which this CrossReference points.

property.name: crossReferenceType
property.shortdesc: The text that precedes or follows the referenced topic.

property.name: customTypeString
property.shortdesc: The text used for a custom cross reference type. Note: Valid only for custom cross reference types.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the CrossReference; this is an alias to the CrossReference's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the CrossReference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
